Market today: The bond market is doing the Fed's job, which Morgan Stanley thinks is good for stocks. This is the main driver for your tech-heavy book.

Your holdings: SOXL (-37.82%) and SPAL (-22.17%) are still in the 'SELL' zone and need attention. They are leveraged ETFs and decay is a major concern, especially on margin.

Watch: Keep an eye on the tech FOMO mentioned in the headlines, as it could continue to fuel your sector, but also be aware of the risks.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your leveraged positions and watching for any signs of a tech pullback.
plays: SOXL: Consider trimming or exiting this leveraged position given the significant loss and decay risk.
SPAL: Similar to SOXL, evaluate trimming or exiting this leveraged ETF due to losses and decay.
No new buys today - hold and watch
